en.io: Input: list/status/pickup/review/complete command and optional slug. Output: handoff status, dispatched build or audit flow, completion review, updated STATUS, archived package, and conventional archive commit.
en.boundary: Operates only on the documented package lifecycle and must not amend the build session's commits during review. Review requires STATUS=built and a valid diff range. Push behavior remains subject to configuration and user confirmation.
dependencies: Hyperflow dispatch, audit, scaffold, and deploy skills
scenarios: List handoffs awaiting build or review.
Pick up a planned package in another environment.
Audit a completed build and archive the lifecycle.

zh.io: 输入：list/status/pickup/review/complete 命令及可选 slug。输出：交接状态、触发的构建或审计流程、完成复核、更新后的 STATUS、归档包和约定式归档提交。
zh.boundary: 仅操作规定的包生命周期；审查时不得修改构建会话的提交。review 要求 STATUS=built 且差异范围有效；推送仍受配置和用户确认约束。
dependencies: 跨会话共享的 Git 仓库
部署交接时的交互确认
scenarios: 列出等待构建或审查的交接。
在另一环境接手 planned 包。
审计已完成构建并归档生命周期。
